channel.title: DailyBite: Daily Healthy Food Deals
channel.description: The best verified healthy food deals, updated every morning.

item.title: Top Pick: Panera: $4.99 Mix & Match Value Menu
item.description: Half- and cup-sized portions of soups, salads, and sandwiches from a 10-item menu for $4.99 each, and every item comes with a free side (baguette, chips, or apple). Pair any two for a full meal under $10 - in cafes and online, no membership needed. (Ongoing)

item.title: Top Pick: Wingstop: 16pc Wings, 6pc Tenders and Fries Bundle for $19.99
item.guid: Wingstop-16pc Wings, 6pc Tenders and Fries Bundle-2026-09-04
item.description: Get a bundle of classic wings, crispy tenders and fries for one flat price of $19.99 through the app or website. (Ongoing)

item.title: Safeway: $5 Friday Sushi Rolls
item.description: Fresh, chef-made sushi rolls including California and Tiger rolls are $5 every Friday at participating Safeway and Albertsons-family stores, no card needed. (Multiple divisions (West, Mountain, Northeast) only) (Ongoing (Fridays only))

item.title: Five Guys: Buy One Burger, Get One Free (code FGAFTERPARTY)
item.guid: Five Guys-Buy One Burger, Get One Free (code FGAFT-2026-09-04
item.description: Log into your free Five Guys account and apply promo code FGAFTERPARTY online or in the app to get a second burger of equal or lesser value free. (Limited time)

item.title: Chili's: 3 For Me from $10.99
item.description: Pick a drink, starter and full entree for one flat price starting at $10.99, available all day at participating locations. (Ongoing)

item.title: Harris Teeter: $5 Sushi Friday
item.description: Select AFC and Zenshi sushi entrees are just $5 today only at participating Harris Teeter stores with a free VIC card. (Mid-Atlantic & Southeast only) (Today only)

item.title: El Pollo Loco: $5 Fire-Grilled Combos: Rotating Value Menu
item.guid: El Pollo Loco-$5 Fire-Grilled Combos: Rotating Value M-2026-09-04
item.description: A rotating lineup of roughly $5 combos (Original Pollo Bowl, Classic Chicken Burrito, taquitos and more) built on citrus-marinated fire-grilled chicken, every day at participating locations. Lineup and pricing vary by market. (West & Southwest only) (Ongoing)

item.title: Subway: Sub of the Day 6 inch Meal for $6.99
item.guid: Subway-Sub of the Day 6 inch Meal for $6.99-2026-09-04
item.description: Get a rotating 6 inch Sub of the Day with chips and a drink for $6.99, or upgrade to a footlong meal for $9.99. (Ongoing)

item.title: Noodles & Company: Delicious Duos from $9.95
item.description: Build a small entree with your choice of protein plus a side like soup, salad or potstickers for one fixed price starting at $9.95, open to all guests. (Ongoing)

item.title: Chicken Salad Chick: 15% Off Catering Orders of $200 or More
item.guid: Chicken Salad Chick-15% Off Catering Orders of $200 or More-2026-09-04
item.description: Enter promo code TAKE15 at online checkout to save 15% on a catering order of $200 or more at participating locations. (South only) (Through Sept 11, 2026)

item.title: Chipotle: $0 Delivery Fee on Pollo Asado Orders of $10 or More
item.guid: Chipotle-$0 Delivery Fee on Pollo Asado Orders of-2026-09-04
item.description: Order Pollo Asado through the Chipotle app or site and get the delivery fee waived on orders of $10 or more. (Through Sept 13, 2026)

item.title: Saladworks: 10% Off Online Catering Orders
item.description: Use promo code SWBTS26 at online checkout to save 10% on a Saladworks catering order. (Northeast & Mid-Atlantic only) (Through Sept 30, 2026)

item.title: Qdoba: $2 Off Digital Orders with Queso Fundido
item.guid: Qdoba-$2 Off Digital Orders with Queso Fundido-2026-09-04
item.description: Enter promo code FUNDIDO on a digital order that includes Queso Fundido to save $2 through online or in-app checkout. (Through Sept 6, 2026)

item.title: Jason's Deli: $1 Large Dr Pepper with Code DOLLARDP
item.guid: Jason's Deli-$1 Large Dr Pepper with Code DOLLARDP-2026-09-04
item.description: Enter promo code DOLLARDP during online or in-app checkout to get a 24 or 32 ounce Dr Pepper for $1. (South & Central only) (Limited time)
